items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: Well, in Biloxi, George Potter, my banjo player

ctx.x: What do you remember about singers singing to the megaphone? Do you remember much about that period?
Yes, yes, who used that? Sure. Who used to sing for you? Well, in Biloxi, George Potter, my banjo player,
was my son. And he sang to a megaphone. When did that go out? When did you start using microphones?
